inputs.description: One week's booking request e-mails, about 15 a week.
inputs.format: plain text, one request per e-mail

samples.description: A made-up week of request e-mails.

glossary.meaning: Two bookings for the same room that overlap in time.
cites: [A:A01 "Clash: two bookings for the same room that overlap in time."]

acceptance_tests.words: When I run a week of requests through it, every clash is flagged and I can approve the list in ten minutes.
cites: [A:A01 "When I run a week of requests through it, every clash is flagged and I can approve the list in ten minutes."]

ranks.what: Reference documents in the context pack
Official documentation on the maker's own site

confidence.high: The row quotes the request line that decided it.
confidence.medium: A reputable secondary source; not expected here.
confidence.low: Inferred or one weak source; such a row is refused and raised as a question.

conflicts: The higher rank wins within its own area.
A conflict the ranks do not settle is reported with both citations, never decided silently.

output.description: One row per request, with a decision: propose, clash or refuse. A request with no room or no time is refused as incomplete; a request outside opening hours is refused with the reason.
